note: Free-exploration content for island B. Positions are Blender coordinates (x east, y north) from nav-island-b.json; quests and their rules stay in world.json and the quest files.

npcs.name: Mira
lines: Pathfinder! You found your way up from the dock.
The numbers promise more apples than we can actually deliver.
Look at the baskets by my door, then find Tove at the market. She keeps the ledger.

npcs.name: Tove
lines: Welcome to the market. Every apple that leaves this dock goes in my ledger.
If the ledger is wrong, the ship sails short.
The Trading Market quest starts at the market marker beside the stalls.

objects.name: Basket of apples
objects.text: Firm and bruised fruit share the same basket. Before anyone counts them, someone has to decide what counts as usable.

objects.name: Village notice board
objects.text: Market prices for the week are pinned here, in three different hands. Two of them disagree about the price of honey.

objects.name: Tove's ledger desk
objects.text: Columns for item, price and quantity sold, and a row of totals that nobody has filled in yet.
